title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Increased access to improved wastewater in the participating cities.

Medan: increased population with access to sewer connections Achievement: 4.2 Progress/Status: Partially Achieved. The percentage of population with access to sewer connection in Medan City was 2.6% in 2008 and increased to 4.2% in 2020. Data Source: Data on sanitation provided by CPMU. National Statistics.

Yogyakarta: increased population with access to sewer connections Achievement: 14 Progress/Status: Overachieved. The percentage of population with access to sewer connection in Yogyakarta was 6.0% in 2008 and increased to 14% in 2020. Data Source: Data on sanitation provided by CPMU. National Statistics.
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 2. Infrastructure development for sewerage completed. Indicator: 100 communal sanitation facilities completed by end of 2020. Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Partially achieved. A total 85 communal sanitation facilities were completed. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: Yogyakarta: increased number of sewer connections Achievement: 27980 Progress/Status: Achieved. In the Yogyakarta subproject, 17,880 additional sewer connections were constructed at the end of the project, bringing the total number of household connections to 27,980. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU

Output: Indicator Indicator: Medan: increased number of sewer connections Achievement: 22832 Progress/Status: Partially Achieved. A total of 11,632 additional household connections were constructed, bringing the total number of household connections to 22,832. The under achievement was caused by the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic in 2020, which caused the community's reluctance to be engaged with the contractor during the construction of the housing connections. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU

Output: 3. Project implementation and capacity development support completed Indicator: At least 30% participation rate of women in community implementation teams (CIT) in planning and decision-making for sanitation facilities development by 2020. Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved: The CIT has 17 women out of 49 (35% against the target at 30%). Data Source: Data provided by CPMU Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: At least 40% of participants are women Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. Capacity development was conducted in the form of training and field visit to observe the implementation of community-based program in Kalipucang where out of 4,154 participants, 1,728 (42%) were women. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y

Output: Indicator Indicator: Capacity development completed Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. Project implementation was completed by the 31 December 2020. Data Source: Data provided by CPMU Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2020 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
